audit_role: isolated provenance and split auditor; excluded from subsequent teacher or curriculum generation
method: Reviewed all prospective family/variant prompt constructions against all frozen user-turn compositions, including target cardinality, operation order, target identity/disambiguation, absolute versus relational units, readback contract, and followup dependencies.

Shared basic DAW capability families alone were not treated as collisions. Near-copy classification requires substantially the same compound objective and dependencies after removing names, literal numeric targets, and wording.
Compared ordered track media kinds, returns, device class and placement, and occupied clip-slot placement across all unique layouts; graph mismatch excludes exact full-state equality.
Confirmed prospective train/valid layout-group separation from selection formula without modifying the frozen manifest.
limitations: Static source/spec audit only: no execution, teacher responses, model scores, builds, network, or Studio access.
Near-composition assessment is semantic review rather than a universal proof against every possible similarity measure.
Applies only to recorded source/spec hashes; later task, layout, or series changes require a new audit.
No frozen prompts, expected answers, hidden checks, or layout details are included in this artifact.
